instruction: Pull over beside the white pickup truck with the metal rack on the left.
paraphrases: Stop next to the white rack-bodied pickup on the left.|Park beside the nearby white pickup truck on the left.

instruction: Stop beside the closest white sedan on the left.
paraphrases: Pull over next to the nearby white sedan on the left.|Park beside the prominent left-hand white sedan.

instruction: Pass the dark car ahead on the left, then stop near the bus farther ahead on the right.
paraphrases: Go past the dark left-hand car and stop by the bus ahead on the right.|After the dark car on the left, pull over near the bus.

instruction: Pass the white vehicle near the far-left barrier, then stop near the white sedan ahead on the left.
paraphrases: Go past the white vehicle by the left barrier and stop by the white sedan ahead.|After the far-left white vehicle, pull over near the white sedan.
What car is in front of us?|Identify the car directly ahead.

instruction: Stop beside the pedestrian next to the white medium vehicle on the right.
paraphrases: Pull over by the pedestrian near the right-hand white medium vehicle.|Park next to the pedestrian beside the white medium vehicle on the right.

instruction: Pass the partially visible white car at the far-left edge, then stop near the white vehicle ahead on the left.
paraphrases: Go past the cut-off white car on the left and stop by the white vehicle ahead.|After the partly visible left-edge car, pull over near the white vehicle on the left.

instruction: Stop beside the yellow tanker on the left—correction, stop near the construction truck on the right.
paraphrases: Take the yellow tanker on the left—rather, the construction truck on the right.|Stop near the construction truck on the right, not the yellow tanker.

instruction: Stop beside the closer white SUV on the right, not the red truck farther ahead.
paraphrases: Take the nearby white SUV on the right, not the more distant red truck.|Pull over by the white SUV rather than the red truck ahead.

instruction: Pull over near the small white vehicle ahead on the right.
paraphrases: Stop next to the small white vehicle on the right.|Park by the white vehicle in front on the right.
